steps.label: S1
steps.title: Step 1: Developing the Prototype Classification System
steps.input: six BCT classification systems identified by a literature search
steps.output: the prototype classification system (distinct BCTs with labels and definitions)

steps.label: S2
steps.title: Step 2: Delphi Exercise First Round
steps.input: the prototype BCT list from Step 1 and the study definition of a BCT
steps.output: ratings plus newly identified BCTs to be presented in the second Delphi exercise round

steps.label: S3
steps.title: Step 3: Delphi Exercise Second Round
steps.input: the BCTs identified as requiring further consideration in Step 2
steps.output: a refined BCT list resolved by the study team from the round responses

steps.label: S4
steps.title: Step 4: Feedback from the International Advisory Board
steps.input: the refined BCT list from the Delphi rounds
steps.output: advice from the International Advisory Board and a further refined BCT list

steps.label: S5
steps.title: Step 5: Reliability Testing Round 1
steps.input: 45 intervention descriptions and the refined BCT list
steps.output: inter-rater reliability results of round 1 and the amended BCT list

steps.label: S6
steps.title: Step 6: Investigating Hierarchical Structure of the BCT List
steps.input: the developed list of BCTs (delivered via an online open-sort grouping task)
steps.output: labeled groups of BCTs from hierarchical cluster analysis with the word frequency analysis

steps.label: S7
steps.title: Step 7: Reliability Testing Round 2
steps.input: 40 intervention descriptions and the amended list
steps.output: reliability scores for BCTs observed at least five times by either coder

steps.label: S8
steps.title: Step 8: Feedback from Study Team Members
steps.input: the BCT definitions produced by the previous steps
steps.output: the final taxonomy v1 list after study team feedback (Electronic Supplementary Materials Table 2)
